title: Baby Dolls promise unforgettable experience in first major concert
summary: P-pop group Baby Dolls is gearing up for its first major concert, Baby Dolls: Ooh La Live! sa Skydome, on Nov. 8, with the group promising fans an interactive and intimate experience.
